sources.name: Breakcold launch history and reviews
keyThemes: Breakcold originally launched February 22, 2022. Product Hunt reports 5 reviews at 4.0, with praise for LinkedIn and email workflows and support, plus a severe account-access complaint.

sources.name: Breakcold official website
keyThemes: Official scope covers a social-selling CRM that brings LinkedIn, email and prospect engagement into a sales pipeline.

sources.name: Breakcold reviews on G2
keyThemes: G2 reports 119 reviews at 4.7. Users emphasize LinkedIn prospecting, social feeds and data aggregation. Review sources include organic, thank-you-page and invited submissions.

sources.name: Breakcold reviews on Trustpilot
keyThemes: Trustpilot reports 4 reviews at 3.7. Positive reviews praise LinkedIn integration and technical support; negative reviews allege renewal, refund, support and lifetime-license access problems.

sources.name: Breakcold reviews on Capterra
keyThemes: Capterra hosts verified Breakcold reviews. At least part of the review collection includes vendor-referred reviewers offered a nominal incentive.

sources.name: Breakcold lifetime-deal dispute on Reddit
keyThemes: AppSumo buyers dispute whether a new version should be included in prior lifetime purchases. The thread captures recurring concern about updates, access and the meaning of lifetime SaaS terms.
